findings.name: Long Page Title (Truncation Risk)
findings.evidence: Title is 71 characters ('Cozy-D Heating and Air Conditioning - Dallas-Fort Worth HVAC...').
findings.explanation: Titles over 60-65 characters are often truncated in Google search result snippets.
findings.suggested_improvement: Shorten the title to under 60 characters so the entire message is visible in search snippets.

findings.name: Multiple H1 Headings
findings.evidence: Found 126 H1 tags: ['At Cozy-D Heating & Air Conditioning', 'We understand that North Texans experience discomfort when they have heating or cooling problems.']
findings.explanation: While search engines can handle multiple H1s, best practice recommends a single main H1 headline per page for clear topical hierarchy.
findings.suggested_improvement: Maintain one primary H1 for the page topic and use H2/H3 for supporting sections.

findings.name: Missing Canonical Tag
findings.explanation: Canonical tags tell search engines the preferred URL version, preventing duplicate content dilution between http/https or www/non-www.
findings.suggested_improvement: Add <link rel='canonical' href='https://cozydair.com/'> to the <head> of the page.

findings.name: Images Missing Alt Attributes
findings.evidence: 56 of 59 images (95%) lack descriptive alt text.
findings.explanation: Alt attributes provide accessibility for visually impaired users and allow search engines to understand image context.
findings.suggested_improvement: Add descriptive, keyword-relevant alt attributes to informative images.

findings.name: No Schema.org Structured Data Detected
findings.explanation: Schema markup (such as LocalBusiness, Service, Organization) helps search engines parse business details, reviews, and service areas for rich search snippets.
findings.suggested_improvement: Implement LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with address, phone, opening hours, and service categories.

findings.name: Missing robots.txt File
findings.explanation: A robots.txt file guides search engine crawlers on which sections of the site to scan and locates your sitemap.
findings.suggested_improvement: Create a standard robots.txt file declaring User-agent: * and linking to your XML sitemap.
